headline: FIA targets a downforce cut for 2027, Allison says teams will try to recover it
body: Mercedes technical director James Allison says the cars will lose "more than a bit" of downforce under the 2027 regulations. Early reports put the target at 20 to 50 points, with several rear aerodynamic elements to be banned. Allison said it will be interesting to see whether teams accept the cut or recover it.
